Rust content suite, clippy and fmt clean for the new 4pc file; production code untouched (generic additive-pack interpreter path, no new mechanism).
decision: Both Suit9 thresholds are unconditional static modifier packs (empty ConditionArray) handled by the generic additive-pack interpreter: 2pc Heal_2 grants HPMaxUp +0.1, 4pc Heal_4 grants HealUp +0.2. No per-set adapter, GearProcConfig variant, or Studio special-case is needed. The scaffolded GearProcConfig::TheasTavernHp and the sets/theas_tavern validate/damage/project stubs are dead code and must be removed (exact lines listed in the agent report).
hypothesis_rationale: DT_EquipmentSuitData binds Suit9 thresholds 2 -> Heal_2 and 4 -> Heal_4; DT_EquipmentModifyData defines Heal_2 as additive HPMaxUp 0.1 and Heal_4 as additive HealUp 0.2, both with empty ConditionArray. The generic interpreter (crates/data/src/native.rs apply_additive_pack) applies such packs unconditionally in the native geometry compiler and in stat_projection, which the tests pin end-to-end at each layer. No native trigger, stack, expiry, or target-selection evidence exists for either threshold, so there is no live proc to model.
independent_oracles: Frozen Heal_2 PropValue 0.1 reads as the exact fraction 1/10 in the threshold-2 set contribution.
Edgar's SlotsEffect_edgar specialization pack grants HPMaxUp +0.1 per size-3 module; the test packing has 4 such modules (Hen3, Shu3, ZhiJiao1, ZhiJiao2), giving 2/5.
Additive HPMaxUp zone composition: 1/10 + 2/5 = 1/2 in known_attributes.
Hand computation hp = character_hp * (1 + HPMaxUp) + HPMaxAdd from the compiled native base receipts matches known_derived_stats hp_receipt and the projected integer hp.
Sakiri's native base pack DT_PlayerPackData.rows.Sagiri_base lists HPMaxUp 0.0, so set_count=1 yields exactly 0.
Studio set_count=2 yields hp_percent 1/10 and healing_bonus 0; set_count=4 yields hp_percent 1/10 and healing_bonus 1/5; set_count=1 yields both zero.
Heal_2 evidence appears exactly when count >= 2; Heal_4 evidence appears exactly when count == 4.
4pc static: Studio/native set_count=4 yields HealUp exactly 1/5 with Heal_4 evidence; counts 0..3 yield zero and no Heal_4 evidence.
Heal zone additivity: manual healing_bonus 1/4 plus the 4pc pack gives 9/20, not (5/4)x(6/5) = 30/20; with only 3 pieces the manual 1/4 stands alone.
limits: Both thresholds are static; any live/on-hit/on-heal behavior beyond the static packs is unmodeled because the frozen evidence defines none.
Studio set_count declares threshold applicability; native equipped builds validate actual console packing geometry. Full acquisition/release availability remains unverified.
The 4pc HealUp value feeds the existing healing_bonus domain (combat.live_healing_modifiers_v1 where supported); combat-side healing settlement is unchanged.

native_build_applies_static_heal_four_piece: equipped native build (legal_native_build, 4 shapes): the threshold-4 set_unconditional_pack contribution carries HealUp exactly {1,5} with Heal_4 evidence; sanity: threshold-2 contribution carries HPMaxUp {1,10} in the same build. project_build_stats is NOT asserted on the equipped Sakiri build: the projector rejects it with "fractional build HP requires an evidenced quantization policy" (pre-existing projector limit, unrelated to Heal_4; HealUp never enters hp, pinned by the projection test).

four_piece_static_projection_applies_at_threshold: stat_projection set_count 1..4: HealUp is 1/5 exactly at 4, zero below; Heal_4 evidence iff count == 4; derived hp_receipt equals the hand-computed base*(1+HPMaxUp)+HPMaxAdd (HealUp does not leak into hp).

studio_four_piece_healing_bonus_applies_at_four_pieces: Studio 0..=4: healing_bonus is (1,5) iff count == 4 else (0,1); HealUp never in unmodeled_attributes; Heal_4 evidence iff count == 4; Heal_2 evidence iff count >= 2. Extends (does not duplicate) the existing four-piece regression in the 2pc file.

heal_up_sums_within_single_zone_not_multiplicatively: Studio manual healing_bonus 1/4 + set_count=4 -> 9/20 (additive single zone per COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT section 5); the multiplicative reading would give 30/20 and is rejected; at set_count=3 -> 1/4.

honest_boundaries.tested: 4pc HealUp 1/5 applies exactly at threshold 4 in three layers (native equipped contributions, stat_projection, Studio); absent below 4; frozen rows pinned; additive zone composition 9/20 rejects the multiplicative 30/20; invalid Studio configs rejected.
honest_boundaries.frozen_derived: 0.2 reads as the exact fraction 1/5; empty ConditionArray makes the pack unconditional; no native triggers, stacks, or expiry exist for Heal_4.
honest_boundaries.hypothesis: HealUp feeds the outgoing heal-bonus zone (combat.live_healing_modifiers_v1 where supported); GearProcConfig::CastleHealingBonus is a live castle weapon proc and is NOT the reference for this static path.
